description: This is a Java integration test class for testing persistence and querying of 'things' with mixed version attributes (V1 and V2) in the Eclipse Ditto project. It sets up test data, performs queries, and verifies the results.

classes.name: MixedV1AndV2ThingsIT
classes.description: Integration tests class for querying 'things' with mixed V1 and V2 attributes in persistence layer.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method that runs before each test; inserts test 'things' with V1 and V2 attributes.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Initializes and persists test data for the 'things' with specific attributes for V1 and V2.

methods.name: findAllByLtNumber
methods.description: Tests querying 'things' with attribute 'magicNo' less than 200, expecting specific V1 and V2 items.

methods.name: findAllByStrings
methods.description: Tests querying 'things' with attribute 'cuttingEdge' matching specific string values, expecting certain V1 and V2 items.
